description: The document a `scope = "mediated_call"` Rego module reads as `input`. Companion to policy-input.schema.json, which describes the TREE surface: the two share no keys, and a module type checked against the wrong one is CLOUD-845's defect deliberately introduced. Generated from `Fact::ALL` filtered to `Surface::Hook` by `batten generate schema --surface policy-call` (CLOUD-879); edit the facts, never this file.

call.description: The envelope the harness handed the boundary -- what is being attempted, never a fact resolved about it.

segments.description: `hook::segments` over `command`: one entry per shell-separated element, quote-aware. Anchor a program here rather than on `command`, whose first word is the first word of the whole LINE.

facts.description: The `Surface::Hook` fact set, keyed by each fact's stable lowercase token (`Fact::as_str`). `additionalProperties: false` is the load-bearing line, exactly as on the tree surface: it is what makes `input.facts.receipt` a build-time error rather than an unconstrained `Any` that is undefined forever.

agent-sourced.description: Fact::AgentSourced -- what a command the AGENT ran said (CLOUD-776), or null.

bypass.description: Fact::Bypass -- the BATTEN_HOOK_BYPASS hatch (CLOUD-610). The one fact whose shape is certain enough to constrain.

keys.description: Fact::Keys -- the tracker-key evidence, or null for could-not-look.

pinned-programs.description: Fact::Pinned (CLOUD-1028) -- the program NAMES the project's pin puts on PATH, sorted, or null for could-not-look. Names only: what a program is for, and every byte it would print, is somebody else's fact.

prospective.description: Fact::Prospective -- the SHAPE of what a write would land (CLOUD-758): look, bytes, lines. Never the content, which is where rule 4 is decided rather than promised.

receipts.description: Fact::Receipts -- check -> verdict token, or null for could-not-look.

tasks.description: Fact::Tasks (CLOUD-856). Task NAME -> its normalised argv as a word list, or null where the task exists and is not a single command -- a pipeline, a sequence, a multi-line body. Those two are different answers and a name ABSENT from the map is a third: the task is not defined. Read from a receipt minted OUTSIDE the mediated call, at session start, so this path parses no manifest, invokes no runner, probes no binary and walks no tree. The receipt's key is recomputed from the manifest as it stands, so a record about a manifest that has since moved does not answer -- null for the whole fact, never a task table trusted a little. Also null for an unwritten record, a schema this build does not read, and one past the size cap; a guard comparing against an empty table would permit every substitution it exists to refuse.

waived.description: Fact::Waived -- the rules a live waiver suppresses, with each claimed expiry.

title: batten mediated-call policy input
